title: Stokke Recalls Clikk High Chairs Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The white plastic seat can break, posing fall and injury hazards to children. Units: About 790 (In addition, about 48 were sold in Canada).

title: Best Buy Recalls Insignia™ Air Fryers and Air Fryer Ovens Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The air fryers and air fryer ovens can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 635,000 (In addition, 137,000 in Canada).

title: Eagle Industrial Group Recalls SafeRacks/Monsterrax Overhead Garage Storage Racks Due to Impact Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The hex bolts in the overhead garage storage racks can be defective, causing the rack to collapse from the ceiling, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 12,800.

title: Elite Comfort Solutions Recalls Nectar® Premier Mattresses Due to Failure to Meet Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively at NectarSleep.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled mattresses failed to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 700.

title: Monti Kids Recalls Wooden Push Toys Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The toy's rolling cylinder can separate, exposing the balls inside, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 1,375.

title: MWA Recalls LUXE+WILLOW Heated Blankets Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The blanket can overheat if left plugged in and powered on for an extended period of time, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 4,200.

title: Norwex USA Recalls Ceramic Knives Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The handle on the Norwex ceramic knives can break during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 40,000 (In addition, 2,500 in Canada).

title: The Red League Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The children's pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 910.

title: Diving Inflation Valves Recalled Due to Risk of Hypothermia; Manufactured by SI TECH
summary: The internal part in the valve can malfunction while in use, causing loss of inflation and thermal protection, posing a risk of hypothermia to the consumer. Units: About 1,670 (In addition, about 28 were sold in Canada).

title: Dollar Tree Recalls More than One Million Hot Glue Guns Due to Fire and Burn Hazards

summary: Due to a manufacturing issue, small parts from the products can come loose, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 46,200 (26,400 FAO Schwarz Branded Toy Wood Play Smart Robot Buddy(s) and 19,800 FAO Schwarz Branded Toy Wood Sensory Boards).

title: MTD Recalls Craftsman and Troy-Bilt Riding Lawn Mowers Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The riding mowers can fail to come to a complete stop and continue to move at a speed of about one mile per hour when the clutch/brake pedal is fully depressed, posing a low speed crash hazard. Units: About 6,200.

title: Generac Power Systems Recalls Generac and DR Power Electric Start Pressure Washers Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard

summary: An incorrectly routed battery cable can contact the prop shaft during use, which can result in an electrical short, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,160 (In addition, about 11 were sold in Canada).

summary: The gear shift assembly can detach from the crankcase, resulting in unintentional gear shifting, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 760.
